findings.title: The exposed federated credential loses its storage ID
findings.body: `updateCredential` assigns an ID to the stored recovery credential, but this reconstruction creates a new model using only the codes, date, and label and never copies that ID. The credential returned by `getCredentials` therefore has no stable link to the stored entry (or may expose a different ID), so callers that address federated credentials by ID cannot reliably operate on it, including removal or account credential management. Preserve the stored credential ID on the returned model.

findings.title: The storage fixture allows recovery codes to be reused
findings.body: This validation only checks whether the submitted code appears in the stored list; it never removes or marks the matched code as used. The same recovery code therefore succeeds on every login, unlike the one-time behavior of recovery codes, and the new integration test's single successful login cannot detect reuse or exhaustion bugs. Consume the matched code and test that a second attempt with it is rejected.
